title: Best Way to Maximise Points/Cashback on Purchases over The Next Coming Month
body:
Hi all, my parents are visiting soon from abroad in a month, so I'll be spending decent money on flights / short 3-5 days cruises/ accommodation/ general shopping over the next few months. I'm looking for the best way to earn points or cashback on it.
Do I have any sign-up bonus cards worth getting for this spend?
Any discounted gift card deals that are worth it for this kind of spend?
Thanks for the help in advance!
